name: THE LONG INCARNATION: Alternate Lives Engine
description: A HelixCorp luxury neural sim designed for Tier 4-5 clientele that allows users to inhabit fully rendered alternate-life simulations spanning decades of subjective experience — different bodies, professions, family structures, even different tiers of Meridian society — compressed into 30-90 day real-world sessions using deep sleep BCI immersion. The sim's 'Authenticity Engine' models real social friction, economic precarity, and relationship complexity rather than fantasy wish-fulfillment, making it as likely to simulate a Shelf childhood as a Spire ascension. Players emerge changed in ways that are difficult to articulate.
story_hooks: A Spire heir emerges from a 60-day Shelf-life session and refuses to return to their family, having formed genuine attachments to simulated people they can't stop grieving.
A returnee insists they recovered a real memory during their alternate life — a memory that belongs to someone who is still alive and has no idea it's been accessed.
A HelixCorp technician discovers that one user's session has been running for 14 months without interruption — and the user's physical body shows no signs of distress.
